autosave.description: Protects unsaved changes by saving your playlist state after every edit.

save.description: Save the current playlist on your device.

saveas.description: Save a copy of the current playlist under a new name or location.

defaultloc.title: Default location
defaultloc.description: Destination folder for all downloaded songs.

description.text: Select the audio format for downloaded tracks:

opus.description: Highest quality (native YouTube stream, zero re-encoding; best for modern players)

mp3.description: Universal compatibility (works on all legacy players and car stereo)

m4a.description: Fast and versatile (native AAC stream, instant save, native on iOS, Android, and Windows)

embedtags.title: Embed tags
embedtags.description: Saves artist, title, and album metadata into the file.

embedthumbnail.title: Embed thumbnail
embedthumbnail.description: Embeds album artwork as the file's cover art.

forceipv4.description: Workaround if downloads fail: bypasses YouTube's stricter rate-limits and blocks on IPv6.

downloadargs.title: Arguments
downloadargs.description: Pass custom flags directly to yt-dlp. Advanced users only—invalid flags may cause downloads to fail.
